    # Defensive extraction of fields
    pos = observation.get("position", [0, 0])
    # Initialize move to stay in place
    dx, dy = 0, 0
    
    # Resource collection: seek resource if available
    resource_pos = observation.get("resource", None)
    if resource_pos:
        if resource_pos != pos:
            dx = 1 if resource_pos[0] > pos[0] else -1 if resource_pos[0] < pos[0] else 0
            dy = 1 if resource_pos[1] > pos[1] else -1 if resource_pos[1] < pos[1] else 0
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Pursuit or evasion: move away from closest enemy
    enemies = observation.get("enemies", [])
    if enemies:
        closest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: (e[0]-pos[0])**2 + (e[1]-pos[1])**2)

        dy = -1 if closest_enemy[1] > pos[1] else 1 if closest_enemy[1] < pos[1] else 0
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Territory control: move towards goal
    territory_goal = observation.get("territory_goal", None)
    if territory_goal:

            dy = 1 if territory_goal[1] > pos[1] else -1 if territory_goal[1] < pos[1] else 0
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Default hold position
    return [0, 0]
